title: alyssum montanum subsp. collicola
intro: Alyssum montanum subsp. collicola, commonly known as mountain alyssum, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae, characterized by its small, white or pinkish flowers and delicate foliage. It is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality due to its calming and sedative properties. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Therapeutically, mountain alyssum is used to alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and nervousness, while its bioactive compounds have been shown to have potential in the treatment of various conditions, including pain, inflammation, and microbial infections.
